descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S28 「1,500 个字符的医院查房前：每个化验、用药和检查都保留，第 1,200 个字符之后的计划项仍然变成任务」 A 1,500-character Hospital pre-round: every lab, medication and study is kept, and plan items after character 1,200 still become tasks

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals …（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 1；TFA-92588 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 Pre-round tasks (the plan items) appear in the task list.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 10；TFA-92588 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given The make-session Hospital patient (Community-acquired pneumonia), nothing else on file

When Type the long text below into the pre-round box, Save Note, look at the Pre-Round panels, then the Encounter tab's Tasks

Then Labs hold all 12 labs, Medications all 7 drugs with their doses, Diagnostic Testing all 3 studies; no panel shows its empty state except Vitals; the two plan items at the end (ask ID about removing the PICC line, a repeat echocardiogram for Friday) are tasks

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs: lab names and decimal values, drug names with doses, study words, and the two plan items on the Tasks list. Code read predicts cp2 Fails: usePreRoundProcess.ts sends input.trim().substring(0, 1200) to extractTasks, and the plan starts at character 1404. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
